original.target_description: Study 1; young adult monolinguals/bilinguals; median correct reaction times; switch status by language status interaction in local-switch-cost ANOVA.

n.location: Participants, article p. 2 (PDF p. 3); Results, article p. 4 (PDF p. 5)
n.quote: Sixty-eight young adults (44 female; M = 19.1 years old; 37 monolinguals) participated [...] Two participants (both monolingual) were removed because of error rates in a cell greater than 25%.
n.sample_role: Participants in median reaction-time ANOVA: 35 monolinguals and 31 bilinguals; analytic total established as 68 recruited minus 2 excluded, corroborated by F(1,64).
n.exclusions: Two monolingual participants excluded for cell error rates >25%; only correct-response trials preceded by a correct-response trial included.

es.quote: Neither the language status main effect nor the interaction ... reached significance, Fs < 1. Analysis using mean RTs

p.location: Results, printed article p. 5 (PDF p. 6 including cover)
p.quote: Neither the language status main effect nor the interaction reached significance, Fs < 1.

replication.target_description: Study 1; final young adult monolingual/bilingual sample; correct reaction times; switch status by language status interaction in local-switch-cost ANOVA.

n.quote: this resulted in a final sample of 78 participants. This sample comprised 31 bilinguals (80.65% female) and 47 monolinguals (66% female).
n.sample_role: Final analytic participants in reaction-time ANOVA: 31 bilinguals and 47 monolinguals; F denominator df 76 corroborates full final sample.
n.exclusions: Initial 92: 3 excluded for elementary English, 3 for pure-block accuracy below 70%, 8 outliers (±3 SD on pure or switch blocks). Only correct-response trials included; data points ±3 SD removed.

es.location: Results, LSC 2 x 2 ANOVA, switch status by language status interaction
es.quote: nor was there a significant interaction [F(1,76) = 1.174, p =.282, η 2 p =.015]

p.quote: nor was there a significant interaction [F(1,76) = 1.174, p =.282, η 2 p =.015].

reported_success.quote: In contrast, mixed evidence was found for local switch costs.

notes:
Original supplied page locator counts the PDF cover; actual article pages are 4 for GSC and 5 for LSC. Original analytic n is established from explicitly reported recruitment and exclusion counts, not a printed analytic-total numeral. Success verdict is the authors’ narrative for the LSC family, not a separately stated verdict for this individual ANOVA term. Printed metric preserved; no effect-size or p-value conversion. Original requested named effect size not printed; printed bounded F statistic retained; exact p not printed.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Target identified by its named ANOVA factor and outcome. Retained the printed F without conversion. The source supplies only the F bound for this effect.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Named reaction-time factorial effect matches the description; retain printed partial eta squared and, where assigned, the p value/bound from the identical ANOVA test.
